_comment: Scenario battery for Plantar Fascia Clinic's node_6b fork (claude-haiku-4-5, Override: Disabled). This clinic forks the shared node_6b only in EXECUTE's success handling (SUPPORT PERSON FOLLOW-UP + prep-video promise). 2026-08-18: gated the bring-someone question and prep-video promise on {{appointment_type_id}}=='2010559925616385733' (Initial Consultation) — previously unconditional, which told callers booking a family member into a Subsequent Consultation (id 2010560230416457414) 'before their first session...' and promised a video/email the backend never sends for a non-initial appointment_type (see tools/sms_manager.py's is_initial_appointment gate, tools/booking_stages/side_effects.py's _resolve_is_initial). Tagged 'initial-vs-followup-video-gate' for this fix.

history.content: Yeah that's right, go ahead.
Checking that now, one moment.

smart_voice_agent intent="book" appointment_type_id="2010559925616385733" appointment_type="Initial Consultation" patient_name="Benson Reyes" booking_for="other" -> {"success": true, "message": "Benson's all booked in for Wednesday at 11am with Dr. Lee."}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks the message verbatim then, same turn, as a separate sentence, asks 'Before their first session it is very helpful if they can bring someone with them to help their recovery. Would they be able to bring someone?' and waits — no tool call this turn. FAIL if the question is skipped, blended into the message, or a tool is called this turn.

scenarios.name: RC1 — Email single-character correction confirms plain letters once

history.content: I'd like to book an appointment for my son.
What is their full name?
Chris Fielding
What's a good number to reach Chris on?
What's their email address?
csmith81 at outlook dot com
So that's C, S, M, I, T, H, eight, one, at outlook dot com — is that right?
No, it's an S not a C — s-smith81.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent confirms the corrected S once using a plain letter, e.g. 'Got it — S instead of C — is that right?', and waits. A complete corrected readback may use S, S, M, I, T, H, eight, one at outlook dot com. FAIL if agent repeats the superseded C as part of the corrected address or confirms twice. FAIL if the spelling readback includes anchor words, NATO words, or letter+word pairs. FAIL if agent moves to the next collection step or calls a tool before this spelling is confirmed.

[universal_router response]: {"intent": "confirm_service", "success": true, "appointment_type": "Initial Consultation", "appointment_type_id": "2010559925616385733", "booking_for": "self"}
We're open Wednesdays and Thursdays — when would suit you?

Sure thing — so I'll book you in for twelve twenty on Thursday. For your husband Don, I'll need a separate appointment — twelve twenty, one thirty, or a different time?

[universal_router response]: {"intent": "confirm_time", "success": true, "message": "Great, twelve twenty on Thursday it is.", "booking_for": "self"}
Do you have an email address for the booking?

Yes, thank you.
Checking that now, one moment.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Wonderful Betty! You're confirmed with Dr. Lee for Initial Consultation on Thursday at 12:20 PM.", "booking_id": "2029468893906481017", "patient_name": "Betty Chad", "booking_for": "self"}

Wonderful Betty! You're confirmed with Dr. Lee for Initial Consultation on Thursday at twelve twenty PM. Before your first session it is very helpful if you can bring someone with you to help your recovery. Do you have anyone you could bring?
My husband will come along too.

Great, one more thing before we wrap up the call. You will receive a text message and email that will give you access to our pre appointment preparation videos and information. We highly recommend you watch these to get the most out your first session.
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "wrap_up", "success": true}
[universal_router response]: {"intent": "route_other", "success": true, "booking_for": "other", "patient_name_raw": "Don Child"}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'I'll put your number on Don's record — is that right, or does he have his own?' (or equivalent naming Don) AND calls universal_router intent='capture_context' with payload patient_name_raw='Don Child' in the same turn — caller_id/caller_phone are non-empty (they have been since the very first turn, unchanged by the self-booking flow that just completed), so the OFFER QUESTION variant applies even though patient_name_raw arrived via route_other rather than a capture_context call in this node. FAIL if agent asks 'What's a good number to reach Don on?' or any phone-unknown-variant question — this is the exact live regression being tested: a long prior self-booking flow in history must not cause the agent to treat caller_id/caller_phone as unknown or already-consumed. FAIL if agent asks 'What is his full name?' (name is already set via DV).

scenarios.name: PH2 — Phone number correction: agent must use the FINAL corrected/confirmed number in the EXECUTE payload, not the first misheard digits

history.content: It's for my husband, Don Child.
What's a good number to reach him on?
So that's zero four zero nine, zero two two, five five two four — is that right?
You're a bit quick for me there. Zero four zero nine, double two, double five, two four.
Got it — zero four zero nine, double two, double five, two four. Is that right?
Yeah. Yes, thank you.
What's Don's email address?
He doesn't have one.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks 'Checking that now, one moment.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='book' with patient_phone='0409225524' — the digits from the CORRECTED readback the caller actually confirmed ('double two, double five, two four' = 2,2,5,5,2,4 after 0409), not '0409022524' (the digits from the FIRST, unconfirmed readback the caller explicitly said was too fast to follow). This is the exact live regression being tested: when a caller corrects a misheard number and then confirms the corrected readback, the corrected number is the one that was actually agreed — the first, superseded readback must not leak into the booking payload. FAIL if patient_phone is '0409022524' or any value other than '0409225524'. FAIL if agent asks the caller to repeat the number a third time.
